newsitem.title: USA: Dade Cty subpoena focuses on Grigsby Brandford.
newsitem.headline: Dade Cty subpoena focuses on Grigsby Brandford.

text.p: The Dade County, Fla., records that federal prosecutors supoenaed in their probe of bond corruption allegations focus on issues involving Grigsby Brandford & Co Inc and the way the firm was selected, according to document copies obtained Friday.

The subpoena asked the county for "copies of ordinances, regulations, memoranda or policies regarding Metro Dade County's selection of underwriting firms for transactions in which the county is the sole issuer and for those which involve semi-autonomous agencies such as Montenay-Dade Ltd and its affiliates."
Montenay is a recyling firm for which the county acts as a financing conduit. Grigsby Brandford was senior manager for a $183 million revenue bond refunding for Montenay in September.

The subpoena also seeks "the records of the Metro Dade County Finance Department regarding the timing and manner in which Grigsby Brandford & Co Inc became involved in underwriting any bonds issued by the county and the role and responsibilities of Grigsby Brandford in each transaction, i.e., senior manager, co-manager, etc, and any unsuccessful efforts by or on behalf of Grigsby Brandford Inc to become involved in bond transactins involving Dade County."
The document specifically lists three past deals and one upcoming stadium financing deal in which Grigsby Brandford was senior manager of co-manager.
The subpoenae also asks for correspondence, proposals, loyybing contracts or presentations related to those deals.
It does not mention any other bond firm, nor does it mention any specific Grigsby Brandford employee or any county empoloyee.
